_comment: How much Arabic a learner knows, shown as "Your Arabic" (Grow's "Level 3" is XP, a different thing). Chosen on Home's first visit or at sign-up, kept on the account's shelf (key `storage-key`), changeable in Settings and the profile until the answers settle it (lib/learner/learnerLevel.js). `start`: the tab and place Home's picker opens. `grow`: the world Grow's Today leads with. `quiz-bank`: the Quiz's set until another is picked. `proof`: the modules whose answers show this level is mastered; the top level has none, nothing is above it.
_comment-evidence: A tier counts once its proof modules hold `min-answers` answers: `pass` or more right moves the learner past it, under `fail` puts them back on it.
